name: Repo Structure
rationale: Forces agents to create responsibility-owned folders before app-level files grow into monoliths.

sources.label: architect-mcp anti-monolith rule
sources.note: Repository structure should encode ownership so generated code has obvious boundaries.

rules: Create directories by responsibility, not by dumping everything into app-level files.
Map canonical paths to existing repos before generating files.
Shared code must have more than one real consumer.
reviewQuestions: What responsibility owns each new file?
